In [[complex analysis]], the '''(open) right half-plane''' is the set of all points in the [[complex plane]] whose [[real part]] is strictly positive, that is, the set <math display="inline">\{z \in \Complex\, :\, \mbox{Re}(z) > 0\}</math>.

[[Image:Righthalfplane.jpg|right|thumb|262px|An illustration of the right-half plane.]]

== References ==

* [[Walter Rudin|Rudin, W.]], ''Real and Complex Analysis, 3 ed.'' (McGraw-Hill, 1986).
* [[Lars Ahlfors|Ahlfors, L.]], ''Complex Analysis, 3 ed.'' (McGraw-Hill, 1979).
* [[Tosio Kato|Kato, T.]], ''Perturbation theory for linear operators'', 2 ed. (Springer-Verlag, 1995)
